title: Google Fitbit Air - Obsidian $199 ($187 via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C/ In-Store) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Google Fitbit Air - Obsidian $199 ($187 via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C/ In-Store) @ The Good Guys

[MushyB] Feel like this is the kind of product which will be included in the Google birthday promos coming up.
[LiamD] There was already a promotion that ended a few days ago where if you bought one of the new Pixels you would have gotten a Fitbit air free
[Lucille Bluth] FYI some features require a monthly $14.99 charge
[just-human] I think most of them are free. Either way it's much better than alternatives which charge much more per year to use the product at all.
[LiamD] I've heard multiple reviewers say that the paid subscription only makes the Google Health app worse because all it does is add pointless paragraphs of AI-generated text under every insight.
[G-Shock] The free subscription is fine and fully functional.
[ritzaus] How do you use the $40 in store only code online after using price beat? Thanks
[just-human] You have to go in-store and most salespeople will match the Price Beat button if you ask so you can get the $187 price.
If you have a code you just present it at checkout and it takes $40 off. Similar to $20 storecash if you've ever used that before.
[hopper] Having Sven is so useful. Not sure if this is to increase battery life
[prankster] I like my inspire 3, mainly so I can see the time, timer, countdown, alarm. This Fitbit air looks like but looks like you need to the app to see the functions as there’s no screen ?
And randomly went on the website and states “Developed with Stephen Curry, Google Health works with your tracker to bring out your best.”
Yeah like he did anything, just sold his name so can get some free money out of this 😂
[DingoBilly] It's a weird minimalist fitness device.
Agree with you completely - Inspire line seems much better value with higher level of control.
[yoogz] It's not really meant to be a smart watch. I use it as a lightweight sleep tracker where the lack of screen is a plus.
It ranks near the top in accuracy in Quantified Scientist's sleep accuracy tests
[Jklaro] I think its pretty much an inspire 3 but with no screen
[Penny Clencher] Have one of these, great product. Battery life i find i get around 7-8 days. Incredibly comfortable and compact, i have no issue sleeping with it on due to its size.
[G-Shock] Same and easy to leave on and forget about it.
As a watch wearer I prefer the minimal tracker and didn't find myself using the charge 5/6 that much as it was never great wearing two watches.
[jimojr] When I first saw Google selling this on pre-order, it reminded me of the free Weet-Bix Active Wristband .
[zanic] Reviews of Google's health app in apple app store are low, is it still worth getting?
